articles.summary: Would it be possible to add lazy edge swipes to the iPad app? similar to what Reeder Classic has. Ever since Apple introduced windows mode for iPad OS, swiping back in the Newsblur app column auto mode when in portrait iPad orientation causes the Newsblur app window to resize. This has been especially bad in the iOS 27 beta release. The only way to go back to the feed list is to tap on the top left button, which is ok, but not ideal.
